# Bibliography Lookup Skill

When given a DOI, title, or description of a research paper, this skill retrieves bibliographic information and metadata from online sources.

**Operating Mode**: This skill operates in agentic mode with file system and web access. It can search online databases, retrieve metadata, and extract relevant information from abstracts or full texts.

## When to Use

- Looking up a research paper, review, or perspective by DOI, title, or description
- Retrieving metadata such as authors, year, abstract, citations, and more

## How to use

- Locate the bibliography file at https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/14_xJBknnO4FEhb5Fq7xLSwSLZw08uOXisdWOKkuA1wQ/edit?usp=drive_link
- Use the "Find" function (Ctrl+F or Cmd+F) to search for a paper by DOI, title, or description
